programme.title: Banorte Trophy - Highlights
programme.desc: The two-round challenge for the Banorte Trophy has 40 riders competing in this CSI5* test of the LGCT Mexico. With a height of 1.55m with a jump-off, this course designed by Javier Trenor has 13 obstacles and 16 jumps and will prove to be problematic for the riders who will have to speed up and offer a clear performance in order to win.Watch the highlights of the Banorte Trophy 2019 edition inside the LGCT.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the latest season of Horse Academy Pro. We welcome our new students: Martina, Lucrezia, Magdalena, Julia, Dea, Carlota and Zoe to the equestrian facilities, and they start getting ready to warm up and receive training from Bruno Chimirri as well as from our trainer, Diego. Find out how their first day to become PROs goes on Horse Academy Pro!

programme.title: FEI Ride Originals - Episode 10
programme.desc: Ride, an FEI Originals series, takes a deeper look into the equestrian world and focuses on lifestyle, horse culture and the fascinating bond between humans and horses both inside and outside the arena.

programme.title: FEI Awards 2021
programme.desc: More than 300 guests including equestrian legends, National Federations, FEI partners and stakeholders have attended the 13th FEI Awards. Equestrian commentator Steven Wilde has acted as the Master of Ceremonies of this international congregation of the equestrian community. The 2020 Award winners have also been present this year in Antwerp - Ingrid Klimke, Semmieke Rothenberger, Carmen Thiemman, Angelika Trabert, the Ebony Horse Club and more. However, in comparison with last year, this time stars of equestrian sports have been able to celebrate in person, bringing together the equine world to celebrate these achievements. This edition of the FEI Awards is more special as it is the FEI's centennial year and the nominees are of the greatest calibre. Find out how the FEI Awards 2021 went on HorseTV.

programme.title: FEI Awards 2021
programme.desc: More than 300 guests including equestrian legends, National Federations, FEI partners and stakeholders have attended the 13th FEI Awards. The 2020 Award winners have also been present this year in Antwerp - Ingrid Klimke, Semmieke Rothenberger, Carmen Thiemman, Angelika Trabert, the Ebony Horse Club and more. However, in comparison with last year, this time stars of equestrian sports have been able to celebrate in person, bringing together the equine world to celebrate these achievements. programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, New Blood - Live In London captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra. The repertoire mixes cover versions from his Scratch My Back album with classic tracks from across his solo career in brand new orchestral arrangements. Gabriel is a renowned live performer and his onstage charisma and instantly recognisable voice combine brilliantly with the orchestral sound palette to breathe a new sense of wonder into familiar songs. As you would expect the concert is also a visual feast, with graphics, animation and imagery blending to enhance and illustrate the music. This is truly a live experience not to be missed.

programme.desc: Watch AC/DC members deliver their signature high-voltage sound in this live performance.

programme.title: Charlie Puth - Live in London 2015

programme.title: Paul McCartney - A MusiCaresTribute
programme.desc: The unmistakable Paul McCartney was honored as Person of the Year by MusiCares at a gala event that brought together several artists to celebrate the Beatles' victorious career.

programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Mary J. Blige - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Leon Bridges - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Justin Timberlake - FutureSex/LoveShow - Live from New York
programme.desc: The FutureSex/LoveSounds album, which spawned the tour, is one of the most awarded 2007 albums and has sold eight million copies worldwide.Sexyback, What Comes Around...Goes Around, My Love, Summer Love are some of the highlights and were among the most played of the year around the world.

programme.title: Fall Out Boy - Boys of Zummer: Live In Chicago
programme.desc: Join multi-platinum band Fall Out Boy as they travel back to their hometown of Chicago for a mind-blowing audio-visual extravaganza. Featuring their newest hits Centuries, Irresistible and Uma Thurman, this 17 song concert also includes the band’s best loved songs from across their whole career. This special performance is one of the most memorable Fall Out Boy concerts ever, filmed during the Boys of Zummer tour that hit 39 North American cities throughout 2015.

programme.title: Robbie Williams - Live at the Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: A brand new show that brings a veteran artist at his best! The talented artist, who became famous in the group Take That, lacks presentations, but he himself begins his show by saying: Let me resubmit .... Robbie Williams has the ability to reinvent himself, exhibiting so much energy that he seems to be a rookie artist. Already in the 40s band of pop music, Robbie is more than an artist consecrated worldwide, is a reference with hits present in the best lists of consecrated DJs. This show at the Roundhouse coincided with the announcement of their 11th solo album, Heavy Entertainment Show, just released. The new album's title reflects Williams' performance as energy-dense as his 11-member big band, including his hits partner Guy Chambers on the piano. A formidable 90 minute pop odyssey. Mixing tracks from his Take That era, old or new, his songs allow him to reclaim his throne from an artist who dominates the stage - in fact, there is no one in pop music who combines his monumental energy with music Touching. A magical moment can be perceived in A Better Man, only with the guitar on stage; Proof that he is an artist that goes beyond the scenery.

programme.title: James Morrison - T In The Park
programme.desc: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994 (the event did not take place in 2017). It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennents.

programme.title: Slipknot - Day of the Gusano
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.title: Chic - Live in London 2013
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007

programme.title: Tom Petty And The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Strat Pack - 50 Years of the Fender Stratocaster
programme.desc: In 1954, Leo Fender gave the electric guitar a new sound and look that fully set it apart from its acoustic counterpart with the invention of the Fender Stratocaster, a solid-body electric axe with a revolutionary three-way pickup system and a modern, streamlined design that was like nothing else on the market at the time. Early rock 'n' rollers such as Buddy Holly and Dick Dale quickly embraced the Stratocaster, and since then it has become the guitar of choice for legendary players such as Jimi Hendrix, Eric Clapton, Stevie Ray Vaughan, Keith Richards, Bonnie Raitt, Mark Knopfler, and dozens of others. The Strat Pack: Live in Concert documents a special concert held at London's Wembley Arena in the fall of 2004, in which a stellar lineup of great rock guitarists came out to say Happy 50th Birthday to the Stratocaster. Performers include Joe Walsh, Ron Wood, David Gilmour, Brian May, Albert Lee, Hank Marvin, and many more.

programme.title: Bastille - Reading and Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of annual music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds, England. The events both happen on the bank holiday weekend in August (on Friday, Saturday, Sunday), and share the same bill (occasionally with one or two exceptions). The festival's origins date to the Beaulieu Jazz Festival (1956–1961) which became the National Jazz Festival in 1961 (The National Jazz and Blues Festival in 1963) and settled in Reading in 1971. In 1999 a second leg was added at Leeds. Featuring : Bastille.

programme.title: a-ha - Unplugged: Summer Solstice
programme.desc: The first a-ha MTV Unplugged Concert ever. The album “MTV Unplugged – Summer Solstice” is being released including a very special LIVE experience.Share the impressive unplugged concert with a-ha in front of astonishing scenery on the picturesque island of Giske, located on the Norwegian coastline.Experience the concert including some hit singles like “Take On Me”, “The Sun Always Shines On TV”, and “The Living Daylights” as well as two new Songs.

programme.title: Duran Duran - The Reunion Tour: Live at Wembley
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable version of their hits: Rio, Hungry Like The Wolf, The Reflex and many more…

programme.title: The Offspring - Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from California. Originally formed under the name Manic Subsidal, the band's lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Bryan Holland, bassist Todd Morse and lead guitarist Kevin Wasserman.

programme.title: Neil Young - Here We Are In The Years

programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-’nérd ‘Skin-’nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. programme.desc: Tracy Fortson was the first female deputy sheriff of Oglethorpe County, Georgia. Her life came crashing down when she was convicted of her boyfriend's murder, but her family believes she was framed and want Chris and Fatima to help prove it.

programme.title: Suomen huutokauppakeisari
programme.desc: Emma Kimiläinen myy Helille Heljää. Pihapöytä tuunataan kaapelikelasta, päivänvarjosta ja tervasta. Aki on tehnyt Erkille eväät huutokauppaan.

programme.title: Savotta (S)
programme.desc: Metsureiden Jukka viettää läksiäisiä ennen ansaittuja eläkepäiviä. Lumi on satanut aikaisin Kittilään, jossa Juho Kangas suuntaa kohti aamuvuoroa. Roope tekee maisemointihakkuuta Haminan suunnalla, ja Antti Ruuskanen etsii yritykselle uusia toimitiloja.

programme.title: BibelPodden - Fallet med den tomma graven
programme.desc: I Bibelpodden dyker Jonas Bergsten, Jonas Dagson, Malin Davidsson och Per Ewert med gäster ner i intressanta spår i världens mest inflytelserika bok. Bibelpodden är ett samarbete mellan Claphaminstitutet och Kristen Media Sverige.Påskens budskap om Jesu uppståndelse är grunden till den kristna tron och historiens största folkrörelse. Hur trovärdiga är Nya testamentets berättelser? Hur står sig budskapet om uppståndelsen inför en ärlig prövning av en sanningssökande skeptiker? I veckans avsnitt samtalar Per och Malin om de förunderliga händelserna i samband med Jesu död, med koppling till tv-dokumentärer, Pers detektivroman Sherlock: Fallet med den tomma graven, och naturligtvis allra främst: Bibelns vittnesbörd om den där unika påskhelgen i Jerusalem för 2000 år sedan.

programme.title: Bushpiloterna - Nytt uppdrag - Del 4
programme.desc: I det fjärde avsnittet av Bush Pilots följer vi Eivind Lindtjørn och Mark Liprini i Tanzania, där en hektisk arbetsdag snart blir helt annorlunda än planerat. I Papua Nya Guinea förbereder sig den nya piloten Renee Brewer för ett uppdrag, tillsammans med den erfarna Glenys Watson – i områden där piratverksamhet är ett verkligt hot. Samtidigt flyger Jan Ivar Andresen och hans fru Linda tillbaka till en by han känner väl, för att besöka en amerikansk missionär och en lokal pastor. Efter en lång dag i luften väntar ett svårt budskap hemifrån Eivind.

programme.title: Föräldrapeppen - Förändring
programme.desc: Vi pratar med Andreas Frankner, pastor och missionär som bott i Ryssland i många år med sin familj. Hur är det att komma tillbaka till Sverige? Hur påverkas man av att bo utomlands under så många år? Kan man förändras? Måste man förändras?Enligt FN barnkonvention så har barn rätt till andlig utveckling. Tänker att det ligger i vårt föräldraansvar att samtala om vad vi tycker är meningen med livet – hur gör man det?Det blir även en del tankar om utanförskap när man inte längre har en gräsmatta. Finns det en klubb även för det?

programme.title: Bushpiloterna - I hårt väder - Del 5
programme.desc: Rebecca och Tajs Jespersen har varit i Danmark ett tag, men nu är de på väg tillbaka till sitt hem i Papua Nya Guinea med sin nyfödda son. Samtidigt kämpar bushpiloterna Glenys Watson och Renee Brewer med dåliga väderförhållanden som sätter deras uppdrag på paus, och medan deras passagerare väntar tvingas de fatta ett svårt beslut. I Tanzania möter Mark och Eivind en oväntad utmaning under landningen, vilket sätter både deras färdigheter och deras beslutsfattande förmåga på prov.

programme.title: Vilda Korea
programme.desc: Koreas livsfarliga gräns - där norr möter söder - är en smal landremsa som i 65 år varit isolerad från världen. Nu är den koreanska demilitariserade zonen en av de vildaste och mest orörda livsmiljöerna för vilda djur i Asien.

programme.title: Ett enklare liv
programme.desc: Ben reser till amerikanska Kaskadbergen där han träffar brittiskfödda Lynx. Hon har levt mer än halva sitt liv i skogen och är övertygad om att ett enklare liv är något vi alla bör anamma. Ben får lära sig stenålderstricken som krävs för att överleva i det vilda.

programme.title: Världens historia
programme.desc: Knut kontrollerar halva England, men krigarkungen Edmund Järnsida samlar motståndet. London belägras och ett stort förräderi får avgörande betydelse. Knut försöker säkra makten med våld och ett taktiskt giftermål.

programme.title: Antikens riken
programme.desc: I en värld där fiender letar efter svaghet, måste våra forntida makter använda all sin styrka och list för att försvara sitt folk och erövra nya marker. Vilka kommer att klara utmaningen på slagfältet?

programme.title: Kungliga skandaler
programme.desc: Suzannah upptäcker äktenskapsskandalen som satte en kunglig person i vittnesbåset, utforskar vad som gjorde Karl II till den glada monarken och avslöjar en sexskandal som involverade en bordell och en kunglig prins. Från medeltiden och fram till våra dagar har det brittiska kungahuset varit föremål för allehanda skandaler. Professor Suzannah Lipscomb undersöker kungliga skandaler genom tiderna.

programme.title: Djurvärldens vinnare
programme.desc: Det handlar om kattdjur, fåglar och apor - alla dessa är vinnare i djurvärlden. I denna serie tittar vi i tur och ordning på vad som gör just dessa arter speciella.

programme.title: Mellankrigstidens drömmar
programme.desc: Del 2 av 8: Freden. En serie om mellankrigstiden baserad på sanna berättelser från livet i en tid full av hopp och förtvivlan. Här följer vi ett antal människors livsöden, via deras autentiska dagböcker, brev och minnen.

programme.title: Så byggdes Sverige
programme.desc: Tidsresan börjar i gruvorten Kiruna år 1927 där Gert Wingårdh vill undersöka om Kiruna verkligen är staden den utger sig för att vara, nämligen världens bästa stad. Men att åka ner i Kirunagruvan skrämmer slag på honom. Samtidigt åker Petra Mede tåg genom brukslandskapet med fd svetsaren och statsministern Stefan Löfven. Mark Isitt reser till Åtvidaberg för att spela fotboll och samtidigt förstå hur en så liten ort kunde vara bäst på så mycket medan Gert undrar vad som blivit Borlänges räddning hemma hos paret Pernilla Wåhlin Norén och Gustaf Norén. Är bruksorten på väg tillbaka igen, och vad betyder det i så fall för Sverige om 100 år?

programme.title: Resfeber: Turismens pris
programme.desc: I grunden har resor alltid drivits av motivationen att upptäcka nya platser, möta nya människor och uppleva nya kulturer. Så varför fokuserar så många destinationer idag på att erbjuda samma saker, samma upplevelser, samma utseende och känsla?

programme.title: På resa med Bachstad: Japan
programme.desc: I Hachinohe sover Øystein i kejsarens säng och Rune möter Jesus. Norrmannen Snorre och hans chef bjuder in dem till en ordentlig runda på stan.

programme.title: Att bli orangutang
programme.desc: Skolskjutsen är inte särskilt lyxig. En enkel skottkärra, bara. Men sitter man ihop med några kompisar som också är föräldralösa och skjutsas av någon man gillar går det bra. Och skolgången är nödvändig för att en dag kunna leva fritt i skogen. Del 2 av 3.

programme.title: Fråga Lund
programme.desc: Kemisten Ulf reder äntligen ut vilken del av jordgubben som smakar mest och bäst. Historikern Gunnar berättar hur det gick till när glödlampan blev symbolen för en idé och så avslöjar evolutionsbiologen Jessica om det finns djur som kan blunda med öronen. Medverkande: Robin Paulsson, Gabriella Stenberg Wieser, Gunnar Wetterberg, Jessica Abbott, Ulf Ellervik och Henrik Widegren.

programme.title: Naturens största talanger
programme.desc: Navigera utan karta? Bygga en fästning av levande kroppar? Inga problem. I Naturens största talanger möter vi naturhistoriska beteenden som har inspirerat några av våra största uppfinningar. Följ med på det intelligenta djurrikets lösningar för att bygga hem, känna sig säker och fånga byten. Del 1 av 3.

programme.title: Alone Australien
programme.desc: Vädret slår om och tvingar finalisterna att se över sin strategi, men att frångå sina rutiner kan avgöra slutet. Vem kommer stå kvar som vinnare?

programme.title: Det hände här
programme.desc: I Njurunda i Medelpad hittar vi en sjöhäxa, ett olöst ufo-mysterium, och en kärleksberättelse där ett ungt par försöker trotsa havets krafter. Anders Lundin och tre historiker åker till små orter för att hitta stor historia.

programme.title: Vilda Korea
programme.desc: Koreas livsfarliga gräns - där norr möter söder - är en smal landremsa som i 65 år varit isolerad från världen. Nu är den koreanska demilitariserade zonen en av de vildaste och mest orörda livsmiljöerna för vilda djur i Asien.

programme.title: Electronic Vibrations - A sound changes the world
programme.desc: Whether techno or hip-hop – electronic music is nowadays the driving force of pop culture. We have almost forgotten that its origins lie in the WDR’s electronic studio, which made Cologne to one of the centres of the avant-garde during the post-war years. This is the story of how a room full of strange devices would become a cabinet of curiosities, the vibrations of which sent the whole world in a state of ecstasy. From the beginnings directly after the Second World War in Paris with Pierre Schaeffer’s ‘musique concrète’, the film focuses on Stockhausen and goes on to Kraftwerk, from Jean-Michel Jarre and the IRCAM studio right up to Detroit to the beginnings of techno.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.desc: The FIA European Truck Racing Championship is the biggest, most imposing racing series in the world. programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: One of the selling points of SUVs is their off-road capabilities, but that's a feature that is rarely used in practice. Buyers opt rather for the off-road look. Whether it's a jacked-up station wagon like the Volvo V60 Cross Country or the Seat Tarraco, which with seven seats becomes the van of modern times: The crossover character is absolutely trendy these days.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Auto Union is the incredible story of the 'Fantastic Four': Horch, Audi, DKW and Wanderer. The four brands of Auto Union are automobile pacemakers, build technical milestones and the fastest car in the world. Today, the name is long gone, but the brand lives on.

programme.title: MotorStories
programme.desc: Kati and Patrick from Munich are huge fanas of US cars and proud owners of a 1972 Chevrolet Chevelle. But they are no longer satisfied with its 5.7-liter small block and want to buy a bigger engine. For that reason they're visiting the engine specialists from Down Town Garage, who store more than 50 engines - from powerful stroker to rare flathead engines. Part of the location is also an American diner with a motel. There you can spend the night in proper style, for example in the Garage Room with its own V8 table. But before the Chevelle can get a more powerful engine, the periphery items must be updated, which means that the front axis is modified. A sportier kit with new wishbones, damper

It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks.

An inspiring and revealing look at what it really takes to make it to the top.

MOTORVISION TV talks to designers and engineers about the new A8 and offers insight into its development.

programme.desc: There is hardly anything that inspiries Ola Stenegard, Chief Designer at BMW Motorrad, as much as his trips through California. While meeting these bikers, Porsche Outlaw Magnus Walker discovers his admiration for custom bikes.

Since opening in 2004, the number of produced cars has almost been doubled to 60 units a day.

Whether it's a jacked-up station wagon like the Volvo V60 Cross Country or the Seat Tarraco, which with seven seats becomes the van of modern times: The crossover character is absolutely trendy these days.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Auto Union is the incredible story of the 'Fantastic Four': Horch, Audi, DKW and Wanderer. With the sign of the four rings, they are the second-largest automotive group in Germany behind Opel in the 1930s. The four brands of Auto Union are automobile pacemakers, build technical milestones and the fastest car in the world. Today, the name is long gone, but the brand lives on.

programme.title: MotorStories
programme.desc: Kati and Patrick from Munich are huge fanas of US cars and proud owners of a 1972 Chevrolet Chevelle. But they are no longer satisfied with its 5.7-liter small block and want to buy a bigger engine. For that reason they're visiting the engine specialists from Down Town Garage, who store more than 50 engines - from powerful stroker to rare flathead engines. Part of the location is also an American diner with a motel. There you can spend the night in proper style, for example in the Garage Room with its own V8 table. But before the Chevelle can get a more powerful engine, the periphery items must be updated, which means that the front axis is modified. A sportier kit with new wishbones, damper

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad 2024
programme.desc: The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles. Nearly vertical cliffs have to be climbed, demanding time challenges have to be solved or spectacular aquaplaning stunts have to be performed.

programme.title: Australian Boat Racing 2025
programme.desc: Australian Circuit Boat Racing offers high-speed thrills on the water, where precision and speed decide intense races on demanding courses. Spectacular competitions captivate motorsport fans across Australia.

programme.title: UIM F1H2O World Powerboat Championship 2025
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: NZ Jetsprint Championship 2025
programme.desc: The New Zealand Jetsprint Championship is the most important sprint boat competition from New Zealand, the country where the sport was founded in 1981. Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks.

programme.title: Australian Boat Racing 2026

programme.title: UIM Aquabike World Championship 2025
programme.desc: Caution, danger of splashing! Since 1992, the Aquabike World Championship has been the most important racing series in the sport of jet skiing and one of the fastest competitions in water sports. On specially designed race courses or on the high seas, the participants engage in thrilling races in the ski and runabout categories and fascinate with all kinds of stunts on their more than 300 hp jet skis.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Extreme Winter Test: We push the Mercedes G 580 EQ to its limits on the snowy Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road and uncover all the pros and cons of the new electric drivetrain. Does the electric G still feel like a true G-Class? And we get an exclusive drive in the new, still camouflaged CLA. With modern features and extremely efficient performance, this model aims to redefine the entry into the brand.

programme.title: Car History

Only with the introduction of the Passat and Golf, Volkswagen finds its way back on track. The Golf is a bestseller. With more than 30 million units sold, it makes the Volkswagen Group a global player. Now, twelve brands are part of the Volkswagen Group.

Participants can look forward to action-packedstages like a quartermile dragrace and 30 policecars. US car fans Kati and her husband Patrick take part in this event with a brand new Chevrolet Camaro. And thanks to the transfer of technology into series production cars, customers benefit from racing victories as well.

Revology Cars are upgrading original 1964 Ford Mustang chassis with modern technology and engines.

MOTORVISION TV talks to designers and engineers about the new A8 and offers insight into its development.

programme.title: MotorStories

While meeting these bikers, Porsche Outlaw Magnus Walker discovers his admiration for custom bikes.

programme.title: Made in...

Since opening in 2004, the number of produced cars has almost been doubled to 60 units a day.

programme.desc: Machli on Ranthamboren kuningatar ja maailman kuuluisin tiikeri, joka tunnetaan rohkeista tempauksistaan. Se on myös saanut peräti neljä pentuetta.

programme.title: Venäjän villi tiikeri
programme.desc: Venäjän villi tiikeri -ohjelma seuraa nuorta luonnonsuojelualueella syntynyttä tiikeriä vuoden verran, kun se jättää äitinsä. Sen reviirin etsintä paljastaa Venäjän Kaukoidän tiikereiden ongelmat ja kiistat, jotka leimahtavat, kun se käy liian lähellä ihmisasutuksia. Katsele paikkoja, joissa sen kohtalo päätetään: laajat metsät, kaukaiset kylät ja kaupungit villinluonnon reunamilla.

programme.title: Leijonien sota
programme.desc: Kuka on todellinen petojen kuningas aina elämää pursuavilta savanneilta vedettömille aavikoille? Kaikki leijonien valtakunnat eivät ole samanlaisia.

programme.title: Elävä paratiisi
programme.desc: Intian sydämessä tiikeriperhe kamppailee hallinnasta kadonneen valtakunnan raunioilla. B1 on nuori tiikeri, joka haastaa vanhan isoisänsä maiden herruudesta. Se käyttää hyväkseen tiikerivanhuksen hidastuneita refleksejä ja huonoa näköä. B1:n emo yrittää pitää uuden pentueensa kurissa niiden ensimmäisen ja hyvin vaarallisen elinvuoden ajan. Sen isästä taas on tulossa yhä avuttomampi. B1 on päättänyt ottaa vallan ja aloittaa oman dynastiansa syvällä muinaisen Intian sydämessä.

programme.title: Maailman tunnetuin tiikeri
programme.desc: Machli on Ranthamboren kuningatar ja maailman kuuluisin tiikeri, joka tunnetaan rohkeista tempauksistaan. Se on myös saanut peräti neljä pentuetta.

programme.desc: Venäjän villi tiikeri -ohjelma seuraa nuorta luonnonsuojelualueella syntynyttä tiikeriä vuoden verran, kun se jättää äitinsä. programme.title: Saalistaja vastaan saalis
programme.desc: Tutustumme maailman voimakkaimpien petoeläinten – jääkarhujen – selviytymistaitoihin. Seuraamme emoa, joka kamppailee ruokkiakseen kahta pentuaan, ja nälkäkuoleman partaalle ajetun nuoren uroksen elämää ja paljastamme taktiikat, joita nämä mahtavat pedot käyttävät hylkeiden, valaiden ja mursujen jäljittämiseen ja väijymiseen.

programme.title: World's Deadliest: Venom
programme.desc: Maalla jokainen hetki on selviytymistesti, ja vain harvat sopeutumat ovat yhtä tarkkoja kuin myrkky. Nämä miljoonien vuosien evoluution muovaamat monimutkaiset toksiinit välittyvät hämmästyttävän tarkasti puremien, pistojen, piikkien ja jopa kosketuksen välityksellä. Ne voivat lamauttaa, häiritä verenkiertoa, ylikuormittaa hermoston tai heikentää saaliin hitaasti, kunnes pakeneminen on mahdotonta. Oli kyseessä sitten käärmeen nopea isku tai komodonvaraanin myrkyllisen pureman aiheuttama hidas, väistämätön romahdus, myrkyssä ei ole kyse pelkästään tappamisesta… vaan hallinnasta. Saaliin, petoeläinten ja itse selviytymisen hallinnasta. Tässä sarjassa tutkitaan myrkyllisen elämän poikkeuksellista monimuotoisuutta joissain Maan ankarimmissa ympäristöissä ja paljastetaan, miten tiede ja käyttäytyminen yhdistyvät tappavassa harmoniassa. Maailmassa, jossa epäröinti voi olla kohtalokasta, myrkky on ratkaiseva etu luonnon jatkuvassa selviytymiskamppailussa.

programme.title: Karibian rannikkovartiosto
programme.desc: Rannikkovartiosto pysäyttää aluksen, joka on täynnä pakolaisia. Sillä välin Aruban lähellä etsintä- ja pelastushelikopteri yrittää pelastaa uppoavan trimaraanin miehistön. Rannikkovartiosto tekee merellä odottamattoman löydön.

programme.title: Turvatarkastus: Ensimmäinen luokka Etelä-Amerikassa
programme.desc: Turvamiehet saavat käsiteltäväkseen todella vaikeita lentoja, joilla kuljetetaan kokaiinia ja laittomia maahanmuuttajia Perun pääkaupungin Liman Jorge Chavez -lentoasemalla ja Brasilian São Paulo-Guarulhos -lentoasemalla. Raskaana olevan naisen kiertoreitti Etiopiaan herättää ihmetystä. Nuoren miehen matka Etelä-Afrikkaan ei vaikuta tavalliselta. Limassa poliisit tarkkailevat lentoja Madridiin.

programme.title: Tucci makumatkalla Italiassa
programme.desc: Stanley uppoutuu tämän villin saaren myytteihin ja arvoituksiin

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is an international competition that allows regular sailors, both pros and keen amateurs, to get a taste of state of the art, flying, foil-born yacht racing at 30+ knot speeds. This competition offers thrilling emotions as pioneered in the America’s Cup, but at a fraction of the cost.Teams compete on a five-event circuit, mostly across Southern Europe, with the aim of raising with victory in the competition. Sailing across destinations as Oman, Riva del Garda, Lagos or Villasimius, the Speed Catamarans of GC32 Racing Tour propose exciting challenges to international teams.Follow the competition now to find out the fastest Catamarans on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form – a direct connection to mother nature.We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up.Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel.Awards:Best Feature Documentary – Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We will visit the beautiful historical city of Šibenik, explore fascinating Šibenik channel and the Krka river, learn a bit about unique coral handmade jewelry, visit a very interesting museum on the island of Prvić and much more!

programme.title: Ride to the Roots
programme.desc: When you have the competition in your blood, there is never an end. You keep looking for more, for the adrenaline rush that comes with it and everyday you thrive to improve yourself. This is the mindset of Adriano de Souza, our protagonist in this episode of Ride to the Roots. He goes back to the favelas he grew up in. Will the happiness of reliving his childhood make him change his career path, or will it be a bigger motivation?

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise
programme.desc: Anchored in Paradise

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: RORC Caribbean 600
programme.desc: The RORC Caribbean 600 is an exciting 600-mile offshore race that takes competitors around some of the most beautiful islands of the Caribbean. In its 12th edition, more than 73 boats from 22 countries joined in a competition with participants from over 37 different nationalities.The fleet is made up not only of professional sailors and their boats, but also with Corinthian amateurs that love this offshore race. As it is the only offshore race in the Caribbean, it gets the attention of the best sailors worldwide. The race starts and finishes in Antigua and weaves its way around 11 different islands including St. Maarten and Guadaloupe amongst them.Be part of this unique race across the Caribbean with Nautical Channel and find out what crew will raise with victory.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The International Canoe Federation (ICF) is the world governing body responsible for administering the sport of Canoeing, which includes both canoeing and kayaking. Governing eight disciplines, two of which are Olympic sports (Canoe Sprint and Canoe Slalom); the ICF delights us with competitions for these sports.While canoe slalom is a timed event where competitors navigate a whitewater course by passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates, canoe sprint is a race to the line on a flatwater course. Both present a challenge for which athletes spend months, if not years, preparing for.Watch this extreme water sport and the two disciplines that take place in the Olympics: sprints and slalom.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The Sprint World Cup from the International Canoe Federation starts in Szeged, in the south of Hungary. This is the first Sprint World Cup of the 2018 season, and 700 athletes from 62 nations have been battling it out for the top spot. Who will raise to the top as the best nation in the sport? Find out on the highlights of the 2018 Sprint World Cup 1 Szeged.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: A Surfing Life: David Van Zyl
programme.desc: David Van Zyl is a young South-African surfer that is quickly gaining popularity and becoming a rising star on the pro-surfer scene. For surf connoisseurs, his name has made history in 2019 as the first International Surfer to ever win the Vans Pro competition in Hawaii. Before then, Hawaiian surfers had an undefeated upper hand that was finally overcome by this young underdog. He now faces new challenges to engrave his name in fame.Get ready to catch some South African waves with David Van Zyl and find out more about his lifestyle on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is an international competition that allows regular sailors, both pros and keen amateurs, to get a taste of state of the art, flying, foil-born yacht racing at 30+ knot speeds. This competition offers thrilling emotions as pioneered in the America’s Cup, but at a fraction of the cost.Teams compete on a five-event circuit, mostly across Southern Europe, with the aim of raising with victory in the competition. Sailing across destinations as Oman, Riva del Garda, Lagos or Villasimius, the Speed Catamarans of GC32 Racing Tour propose exciting challenges to international teams.Follow the competition now to find out the fastest Catamarans on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Today we are taking you to the hidden gems of the Croatian coast. Places of mesmerising beauty but known by few. We are talking about Rogoznica and Primošten! We'll explore the Kornati islands, the destination that amazed the famous writer George Bernard Shaw and much more.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We will visit the beautiful historical city of Šibenik, explore fascinating Šibenik channel and the Krka river, learn a bit about unique coral handmade jewelry, visit a very interesting museum on the island of Prvić and much more!

programme.title: Ride to the Roots
programme.desc: When you have the competition in your blood, there is never an end. You keep looking for more, for the adrenaline rush that comes with it and everyday you thrive to improve yourself. This is the mindset of Adriano de Souza, our protagonist in this episode of Ride to the Roots. He goes back to the favelas he grew up in. Will the happiness of reliving his childhood make him change his career path, or will it be a bigger motivation?

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise
programme.desc: Anchored in Paradise

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form – a direct connection to mother nature.We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up.Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel.Awards:Best Feature Documentary – Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: The Dangerous Waters crewmembers will ride an epic adventure like no other on their JetSki. Their world-first adventure is plagued with wildlife, wicked waters, tropical storms and new unknown challenges they will have to overcome. As the conditions worsen, crewmembers are forced to drastically take decisions in an environment where not all will get to their final destination.Become part of the crew as they battle the elements on their JetSkis, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Jet Ski World Series
programme.desc: Put your helmets on because we are getting started with the Jet Ski World Series! Delivering whooping speeds of 100km/hr in under 3.8 seconds and with 500 horsepower, riders need to be sharp to turn 30 degrees at 140 km/h, putting the 'Jet' in Jet Ski. Wearing no protective body, grappling with the waves and fighting out with gravity, the riders that dare challenge this competition are some of the most corageous athletes in the world. Are you going to miss out? Tune up to the latest edition of the Jet Ski World Series!

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. programme.title: A Surfing Life: David Van Zyl
programme.desc: David Van Zyl is a young South-African surfer that is quickly gaining popularity and becoming a rising star on the pro-surfer scene. For surf connoisseurs, his name has made history in 2019 as the first International Surfer to ever win the Vans Pro competition in Hawaii. Before then, Hawaiian surfers had an undefeated upper hand that was finally overcome by this young underdog. He now faces new challenges to engrave his name in fame.Get ready to catch some South African waves with David Van Zyl and find out more about his lifestyle on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The International Canoe Federation (ICF) is the world governing body responsible for administering the sport of Canoeing, which includes both canoeing and kayaking. Governing eight disciplines, two of which are Olympic sports (Canoe Sprint and Canoe Slalom); the ICF delights us with competitions for these sports.While canoe slalom is a timed event where competitors navigate a whitewater course by passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates, canoe sprint is a race to the line on a flatwater course. Both present a challenge for which athletes spend months, if not years, preparing for.Watch this extreme water sport and the two disciplines that take place in the Olympics: sprints and slalom.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The Sprint World Cup from the International Canoe Federation starts in Szeged, in the south of Hungary. This is the first Sprint World Cup of the 2018 season, and 700 athletes from 62 nations have been battling it out for the top spot. Who will raise to the top as the best nation in the sport? Find out on the highlights of the 2018 Sprint World Cup 1 Szeged.

programme.title: Sail-Ho

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is an international competition that allows regular sailors, both pros and keen amateurs, to get a taste of state of the art, flying, foil-born yacht racing at 30+ knot speeds. This competition offers thrilling emotions as pioneered in the America’s Cup, but at a fraction of the cost.Teams compete on a five-event circuit, mostly across Southern Europe, with the aim of raising with victory in the competition. Sailing across destinations as Oman, Riva del Garda, Lagos or Villasimius, the Speed Catamarans of GC32 Racing Tour propose exciting challenges to international teams.Follow the competition now to find out the fastest Catamarans on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form – a direct connection to mother nature.We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up.Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel.Awards:Best Feature Documentary – Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: RORC Caribbean 600
programme.desc: The RORC Caribbean 600 is an exciting 600-mile offshore race that takes competitors around some of the most beautiful islands of the Caribbean. In its 12th edition, more than 73 boats from 22 countries joined in a competition with participants from over 37 different nationalities.The fleet is made up not only of professional sailors and their boats, but also with Corinthian amateurs that love this offshore race. As it is the only offshore race in the Caribbean, it gets the attention of the best sailors worldwide. The race starts and finishes in Antigua and weaves its way around 11 different islands including St. Maarten and Guadaloupe amongst them.Be part of this unique race across the Caribbean with Nautical Channel and find out what crew will raise with victory.

Harjoitteet sopivat kaikille katsojille.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Auf der Suche nach Kaitlyn, der entführten Enkelin von D.B., hat sich Julie auf einen Abend mit Detective Crenshaw eingelassen, da sie vermutet, dass er für McKeen arbeitet. Tatsächlich findet sie das Mädchen, doch bevor sie mit ihr fliehen kann, wird Julie ebenfalls eingesperrt. Sie bringt Kaitlyn dazu, durch einen Lüftungsschacht ins Freie zu krabbeln. Als Julie wenig später von Brass und Moreno befreit wird, ist Kaitlyn jedoch verschwunden.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Nick, Greg und Sara wollen am Ende der Nachtschicht in ihrem Stammlokal eine Kleinigkeit essen und finden stattdessen ein Blutbad mit acht Toten vor. Der einzig Überlebende ist im Kühlraum eingesperrt. Sara verdächtigt Ronald Basderic, den Stalker der Kellnerin Edi der Tat, doch Finns Rekonstruktion kommt zum Schluss, dass der im Zeugenschutzprogramm befindliche Alex wohl das eigentliche Ziel war. Dann entdeckt Nick eine chinesische Münze.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Bei einem Rave in der Wüste wird ein Mädchen erschossen. Ein zweites Mädchen namens Jacinta, das mit dem Opfer unterwegs war, ist nicht nur völlig verschüchtert, sondern weist wie das ermordete Mädchen Fesselspuren und Verletzungen auf.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Mitten in der Wüste steht ein Flügel. Als das CSI-Team ihn aufklappt, finden sie darin die Leiche von Alison Bailey, einer früheren Freundin von Greg. Der Flügel gehört Tommy Grazetti, der 1966 den Pianisten Ledo Wright ermordet haben soll.

programme.title: Deutschland am Morgen
programme.desc: Dein Morgen, dein Rhythmus: Deutschland am Morgen von RTL und ntv ist der tägliche Begleiter für alle, die bestens informiert und gut unterhalten in den Tag starten wollen. programme.title: Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten
programme.desc: Yvonne entscheidet sich, Gerner die Wahrheit in einem ungewöhnlichen Rahmen zu offenbaren. Toni sucht aktiv nach Antworten und forscht selbst nach. Nihat arbeitet daran, sein falsches Image als wohlhabender Luxusliebhaber zu berichtigen.

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: Anna gibt Ferhat die Kraft für einen würdevollen Abschied von seiner Mutter. Jori spürt, dass Patrizia etwas verheimlicht, und wendet sich an Ute. Esmas nächtliches Verschwinden sorgt für Spannungen zwischen Tobias und Baris.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Larissa Peters findet ihren verschollenen Verlobten Michael Zobel wieder, doch die Wiedersehensfreude ist einseitig. Sie soll versucht haben, ihn mit einer Hundeleine zu erwürgen, wird jedoch von Stefanie Bauer gestoppt.

programme.title: Barbara Salesch - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Polier Ralf zündet die Sauna seines Nachbarn Manuel an, weil dieser nackt durch den Garten rennt. Doch der verwendete Brandbeschleuniger stammt aus dem Baumarkt, in dem Manuels Frau arbeitet.

programme.title: Punkt 12 - Das RTL-Mittagsjournal
programme.desc: Aktuelle Informationen, Servicethemen, jede Menge Lifestyle und das Neueste aus der Welt der Prominenten - das ist nur die eine Seite von Punkt 12. Darüber hinaus gibt es täglich spannende und ausführliche Reportagen und Mini-Dokus, die je nach Blickwinkel verblüffende, schrille oder schockierende Einblicke in den Alltag der Deutschen geben.

programme.title: Barbara Salesch - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Kirsten (38) beschuldigt ihren Bruder Rainer (45) der Erbschleicherei, nachdem er zum Alleinerben ihres Vaters Günter erklärt wurde. Der Schmuck der verstorbenen Mutter gefiel auch Rainers Freundin und Günters Bekanntschaft.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Strafgericht
programme.desc: Jens Hausmann, ein Ex-Häftling und Koch, wird beschuldigt, Kellner Lennart Pöschl mit einer gefrorenen Schweinshaxe angegriffen und ihm einen Teil der Ohrmuschel abgebissen zu haben. Ständige Sticheleien sollen der Auslöser gewesen sein.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - Das Jugendgericht
programme.desc: Die Schülerin Jolie Edmont träumt seit ihrem KiTa-Praktikum von einer Karriere als Erzieherin und arbeitet als Babysitterin für die Familie Winkelmann. Dabei bricht ein Feuer im Haus aus. Jolie kann die fünfjährige Mia nur mit Mühe vor den Flammen retten, doch die Familie verliert ihr gesamtes Hab und Gut. Hat die Schülerin den Brand aus Unachtsamkeit verursacht? Die Aussage einer neugierigen Nachbarin lässt etwas anderes vermuten.

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: Während Ringo und Easy auf Nurays Beerdigung sind, ahnen sie nicht, dass Julius von Alexander bedroht wird. Können sie ihren Sohn noch einmal vor ihm retten? Patrizia verliert mit Jori den letzten geliebten Menschen. Und natürlich weiß sie hasserfüllt, wem sie dafür die Schuld zu geben hat ... Dana registriert eifersüchtig die Nähe zwischen Ferhat und Anna. Nur ein Zögern von Anna, lässt Dana einen kleinen Sieg einfahren ...

programme.title: Explosiv - Das Magazin
programme.desc: Aktuell, mitreißend und gefährlich ehrlich - das ist Deutschlands beliebtestes tägliches Boulevard-Magazin. Explosiv präsentiert die Geschichten, die Deutschland bewegen und regelmäßig für öffentliche Diskussionen sorgen. Das RTL-Magazin knüpft immer dort an, wo die Geschichten der Menschen hinter den News beginnen und beweist, dass Boulevard deutlich mehr ist als nur Sensationsjournalismus.

programme.title: Exclusiv - Das Starmagazin
programme.desc: Wo ein roter Teppich ausgerollt wird, ist Exclusiv nicht weit. Täglich liefert Deutschlands erfolgreichstes Starmagazin die aktuellsten Promi-News, verrät die heißesten Gerüchte und gibt Einblicke in das Leben der angesagtesten Celebrities dieser Welt. Von Hollywood bis Berlin, von royalen Hochzeiten bis zu privaten Glücksmomenten - Exclusiv berichtet zuverlässig und aktuell aus der Welt der Stars und Sternchen.

programme.title: RTL Aktuell
programme.desc: Im Vordergrund der Hauptnachrichtensendung RTL Aktuell stehen die Themen, die wirklich relevant für die Zuschauer sind. Welche Auswirkungen haben politische Entscheidungen, wirtschaftliche Entwicklungen, soziale Trends und Innovationen wie zum Beispiel medizinische Neuerungen auf ihr Leben? Diese an den unmittelbaren Interessen der Zuschauer orientierten Fragen stehen konsequent im Mittelpunkt der Nachrichtenvermittlung bei RTL Aktuell.

programme.title: Alles was zählt
programme.desc: Kilian ist sich sicher, Maximilian nach wie vor in der Hand zu haben - und muss wütend erkennen, dass der ihm seine Trümpfe abgenommen hat. Während Elias alles gibt, um Joana zu helfen, bekommt nicht nur Leyla den Verdacht, dass mehr zwischen ihm und Joana sein könnte. Isabelle will Druck auf die Zieglers ausüben und ist überzeugt einen guten Weg gefunden zu haben.

programme.title: Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten
programme.desc: Yvonne gelingt es, mit Matildas Hilfe eine Überraschung für Gerner zu organisieren. Bei einem besonderen Event will sie Gerner ein Geheimnis offenbaren. Doch das Schicksal scheint sich gegen sie verschworen zu haben ... Als Erik, Nihat und Paul mit vereinten Kräften ein widerspenstiges Wurfzelt verpacken, ist zwischen ihnen für einen Moment alles wie früher. Glücklich teilt Erik diesen Moment mit Matilda.

programme.title: Passagier 23 - Verschwunden auf hoher See
programme.desc: Der Polizeipsychologe Martin Schwartz hat vor Jahren Frau und Sohn während einer Reise auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff verloren - niemand weiß, was genau geschah. Jetzt wird er erneut auf den Transatlantikliner von damals gerufen. Es gebe Beweise dafür, was seiner Familie zugestoßen ist. Nie wieder wollte Martin den Fuß auf ein Schiff setzen, doch dann taucht ein vor Wochen an Bord verschwundenes Mädchen wieder auf. Mit dem Teddy seines Sohnes im Arm.

programme.title: stern TV Reportage
programme.desc: Rund 50 Millionen Deutsche sind ständig auf der Suche nach Schnäppchen, besonders bei Lebensmitteln, Kleidung und Drogerieartikeln. Experten geben Tipps, wie man echte Deals erkennt und Mogelpackungen vermeidet.

programme.title: RTL Nachtjournal
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt des Nachrichtenjournals RTL Nachtjournal steht die vertiefende aktuelle Berichterstattung. Das Thema des Tages wird regelmäßig durch kritische Interviews mit Verantwortlichen aus Politik und Wirtschaft beleuchtet.

programme.title: RTL Nachtjournal Spezial
programme.desc: RTL sendet ein Nachtjournal Spezial direkt nach den Spätnachrichten, in dem Interviewgäste aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft ausführlich zu Wort kommen. Die etwa zwanzigminütige Sendung bietet eine vertiefte Analyse aktueller Themen.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Dem gefährlichen Serientäter Kendrick gelingt während eines Feuers in den Everglades die Flucht.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Ein Frachtflugzeug ist abgestürzt. An Bord befanden sich Schecks im Milliardenwert. Der Pilot gibt an, er sei von einem grünen Blitz geblendet worden. An der Absturzstelle wird eine Frauenleiche entdeckt, die im Flugzeug gewesen sein muss.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Die Ermittler werden zu einem Verkehrsunfall gerufen, bei dem das Opfer zum Zeitpunkt des Unfalls bereits tot war. Es handelt sich um einen bekannten Skateboarder, der seine Tricks einer Firma verkaufte, die Videospiele herstellt.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Häufig sind sie gemeinsam vor Ort, wenn rund um einen Polizeieinsatz medizinische Erstversorgung gefragt ist. Der Blaulicht Report erzählt Geschichten aus dem aufregenden Berufsalltag dieser Retter in Not.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Ausgerechnet an Halloween liegt mitten im Crack-Viertel ein Toter mit aufgeschlitzter Kehle auf der Straße, daneben ein sehr aggressiver Hund, der die Leiche verteidigt. Bei dem Toten handelt es sich um einen Polizisten der Hundestaffel, Officer Nelson, der Hund ist sein langjähriger Partner, Sam. Da bei Nelson Methamphetamin gefunden wird, testen sie das Gespann auf Drogen, doch sowohl der Tote als auch der Hund sind clean. Nick findet Gefallen an Sam und als klar ist, dass dieser mit dem Tod von Officer Nelson nichts zu tun hat, macht sich Nick zusammen mit dem Vierbeiner auf die Suche nach dem Mörder von Officer Nelson... Julie und Morgan versuchen zu ergründen, wer Barry Sloan, den extrem erfolgreichen Scheidungsanwalt, ins Jenseits befördert hat. Schnell ist klar, dass Sloan im Verlaufe des Abends Sex mit mehreren Damen hatte und von außen durchs Fenster erschossen wurde. Morgan findet auf dem Fenstersims einen Fingerabdruck, der von Brent Walsh stammt, einem Mandanten von Sloan. Walsh war misstrauisch geworden, weil sein Anwalt während der Scheidungsprozedur immer großzügiger gegenüber Mrs Walsh wurde und durch seinen Besuch bei Sloan hat Brent Walsh erfahren, dass seine Frau zu Sloans Betthäschen gehört. Allerdings hat er für die Tatzeit ein lupenreines Alibi. Auch seine Ex-Frau in spe scheidet als Täterin aus. Da Hodges auf dem Hemd von Sloan verschmierten Lippenstift eines sehr raren Jahrganges findet, hegt Julie Finlay einen Verdacht...

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Tom Burns, der Basketballtrainer der Western Las Vegas University, wird in der Sporthalle ermordet. Charlie, der Sohn von Russell, vermutet, dass Jack Oxford, der größte Förderer der Universität, etwas damit zu tun hat. Von einem Zeugen erfährt Russell, dass Charlie kurz vor dem Mord einen heftigen Streit mit dem Opfer hatte. Nick entdeckt, dass Burns Kunde bei der Domina Mistress Z war. Diese entpuppt sich als Charlies neue Freundin Vanessa.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Reverend Rick Renken wird auf dem Grab von Warrick Brown mit einem Kopfschuss hingerichtet. Kurz vor seinem Tod hatte er Warricks Witwe Tina besucht. In Tinas Wohnung werden Drogen gefunden, die auf Kontakte mit einem gewissen Cliff Paul deuten. Die Suche nach diesem nimmt ein tragisches Ende: Cliff Paul ist aus dem Fenster gesprungen und verstorben. Über Blutspuren in Cliffs Wohnung stoßen die Ermittler auf einen weiteren Verdächtigen.
